people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.
translations.bsb: The next day Moses took his seat to judge the people, and they stood around him from morning until evening.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
translations.asv: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood about Moses from the morning unto the evening.
